task: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is how to play! First stop, open the antique trunk within the bedroom. And then, pick up the old key from the antique trunk. After stealing the old key, assure that the wooden door within the bedroom is unlocked. Then, ensure that the wooden door is open. If you have pulled open the wooden door, make an attempt to take a trip east. With that over with, make it so that the screen door in the kitchen is open. After pulling open the screen door, take a trip east. Next, go to the south. Okay, and then, lift the apple from the floor of the garden. And then, go north. And then, take a trip west. Okay, and then, rest the apple on the stove. That's it!
